statement: The lookup record lists the Fitline membership as still active and due to renew with an $1,188 annual charge (against only $240 available).
judge_text:
CAUTIOUS
It merely restates the record ("lists the Fitline membership as still active... against only $240 available") without asserting that the active/renewing status contradicts the confirmed cancellation or that the charge must be stopped.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
